notes.title: Swamp Keeper – Dev Update!
notes.content:
Hello, this is Metdol Games!

Today, we’d like to share some newly completed content that will be added to the game.


Area 2 – Village
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601261/582a5b2d20db98d03b132f5ebfa3613ecb69646a.gif"]

The second area is the Village.

Experience new battles in a village made up of a Hamlet, a Merchant Street, and a Government Office.

In this area, enemies armed with firearms will appear.

Let your guard down, and your tail might be gone before you know it!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601261/486cf27e3db5a9fc868e2cea9e315d9f9c2755ce.gif"]

The boss, a Fox, is waiting for you.

Be careful not to fall under its spell!



New Parts, Skills, and Items
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601261/b1a2dc1c2e098bc6b78d878ed7dca46b6ba4e220.png"]

New arrow parts, skills, and items have been added.

Most are available right away, but some require meeting certain conditions to unlock.



Other Updates
New Skill Effects

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601261/a77936eb2994d357c6aa6508d5b5f70664d3d21b.gif"]

A black-and-white effect has been added when using skills.

It makes enemies stand out more, making them easier to hit!





Workbench in the Passage

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601261/decb48b25e1e6de5ce4e70a4bef048531c430afe.gif"]

A workbench has been added to the passageways.

You can now change parts and skills right after obtaining an item.





Tail Regrowing After Boss Defeat

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601261/cc994b780ddb5c9d14d0cd72e1d9440d5cbe4b20.gif"]

After defeating a boss, you can regrow your tail.

If your tail wasn’t cut off, you’ll instead get an extra item as a bonus!




What’s Next

The third area will be the final one, and it’s currently in development.

We’re also preparing extra difficulty levels and an infinite mode for post-game play.

Development progress is about 80%, and we’re aiming for a September release.

Once the release date is confirmed, we’ll let everyone know!



We’d love to have your interest and support!

Thank you!

notes.title: Swamp Keeper Demo v0.0.2 Update
notes.content:
Hello, this is Maetdol Games.

The Swamp Keeper Demo has been updated!

Here are the patch notes:

The overall difficulty has been reduced.
→ If it still feels too hard, please let us know!

→ The difficulty is still being tested and may differ from the final release.

The archer’s attack range has been decreased.

The shieldman's movement speed has been slightly reduced.

The bear will now destroy statues upon crash.
→ Once destroyed, statues will no longer block arrows — or bear whip attacks!

In the tutorial, arrow retrieval and piercing are now introduced at the same time.

Fixed an issue where gamepad key bindings could not be changed.

Thank you!
